name: Market Close Small-Cap Follow-Through Performance Tracker
description: Daily post-market tracker (16:10 EST, Monday - Friday) that downloads 1-minute intraday regular hours data, evaluates execution follow-through (+2% breakout vs critical dump), and logs multi-day metrics to ./data/gappers_history.csv.

steps.name: Compute Execution Metrics
metrics: minutes_to_day_high (minutes from open to peak high)
